title: 新手引导与目标指引不足
description: 新玩家缺乏明确指引，不清楚目标、操作和推进方式，教程质量差，导致挫败感和迷茫。
evidence: Even after playing it for some time you still have no idea whats going on. You create a character with 0 idea whats going on you get on your ship with 0 idea of whats going on.
tried for almost an hour and never found my ship
there really isn't much of a guide explaining what you're supposed to do, or how to progress

evidence_items.quote: the starting areas is a slog
evidence_items.quote_zh: 起始区域是一场苦差事

evidence_items.quote: Quests: These need some work. It's unclear what to do to progress them sometimes without looking up the wiki or discord.
evidence_items.description: 任务推进目标不明确，常需查wiki或discord
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任务：这些还需要一些改进。有时候不查wiki或discord，根本不清楚该做什么来推进它们。

evidence_items.quote: チュートリアルやってくとそのままサルベージに行く流れになってるけど、どう考えてもコロニーでバイトしてEVAスーツとライセンス手に入れてからじゃないのかこれ
evidence_items.description: 教程后直接进入打捞流程，但应该先在殖民地打工获得EVA服和执照
evidence_items.quote_zh: 接着，教程玩着玩着就变成直接去打捞的流程了，但怎么想不都应该是先在殖民地打工，拿到EVA服和执照之后再去吗

evidence_items.quote: Even after playing it for some time you still have no idea whats going on. You create a character with 0 idea whats going on you get on your ship with 0 idea of whats going on.
evidence_items.description: 新玩家不清楚目标和该做什么
evidence_items.quote_zh: 即使玩了一段时间，你仍然不知道到底在发生什么。你创建角色时对正在发生什么一无所知，登上自己的飞船时也一无所知。

evidence_items.quote: this one actually ♥♥♥♥♥ you in the tutorial.  After 4 restarts, half the time dying for reasons I don't understand at all, I just stopped playing.
evidence_items.description: 教程对玩家极不友好，导致多次重开和不明原因死亡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这一款在教程里就真的把你♥♥♥♥♥了。重启了4次，有一半时间都是因为一些我完全不明白的原因而死，我就直接不玩了。

evidence_items.quote: tried for almost an hour and never found my ship
evidence_items.description: 尝试近一小时仍未找到飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 试了将近一个小时，一直没找到我的飞船

evidence_items.quote: the tutorial doesnt update after doing the first tasks, i dont know what to do from here
evidence_items.description: 完成初始任务后教程不更新，不知道下一步做什么
evidence_items.quote_zh: 完成最初的任务后，教程就不再更新了，我不知道接下来该做什么

evidence_items.quote: there really isn't much of a guide explaining what you're supposed to do, or how to progress
evidence_items.description: 缺乏引导，不知道如何开始和推进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 真的没有多少指南来解释你应该做什么，或者如何推进
